ModMetaData.name: Homesteader
ModMetaData.author: AzraelGodKing
ModMetaData.description:
Everything a growing homestead needs: better storage, food preservation, and off-grid power.
STORAGE - Storage crate: a cheap wooden crate that holds 3 stacks and protects them from deterioration. - Storage barrel: holds 3 stacks of food or drink, safe from the weather. - Pallet: a dirt-cheap outdoor pallet that holds 2 stacks of anything - including stone chunks - without deterioration.
FOOD PRESERVATION - Drying rack: turn raw meat into long-lasting jerky, or fruit and vegetables into dried produce. No power or research needed - perfect for tribal starts and early colonies. - Smokehouse: a wood-fired smoker that preserves raw meat as smoked meat, which keeps for a month and can still be cooked into meals.
POWER - Compact battery: a small 1x1 battery for tight bases and early setups. - Battery bank: a high-capacity, high-efficiency 2x2 power reserve. - Portable generator: a 1x1 chemfuel generator for outposts and workshops.
Fully XML-based: no C# assembly, safe to add or remove from a save (remove mod items from the map first before uninstalling).
